sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10462 of 2024
Applicant :- Arun Tiwari @ Raj Tiwari
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Arti Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0121 of 2024, under Section 498A, 323, 506,
304B of IPC & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Gauriganj, District Amethi.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that daughter of the informant was married to the applicant in the year 2022 and sufficient dowry was given, however, the entire matrimonial family used to demand dowry and an apprehension was expressed that the entire matrimonial family member had killed her.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report, is ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other injury was observed on the body of the deceased.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Arun Tiwari @ Raj Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.

5. Considering the post-mortem report and the fact that there is no allegation that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any mental or physical harassment in relation to demand of dowry at the instance of the applicant coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 07.06.2024 the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Arun Tiwari @ Raj Tiwari be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
